 “He’s [President Donald Trump] blatantly laying the groundwork to steal an election if his chosen candidate doesn’t win,” Sen. Tina Smith, the outgoing Minnesota Democrat, wrote in an X post. “Minnesota will not take kindly to thinly veiled threats from a guy we’ve rejected three times (soon to be four).” (JOSE LUIS MAGANA/AP FILE) 
 By Ray Lewis | Sinclair National Desk PUBLISHED: October 28, 2026 at 8:19 AM EDT Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... "He's [President Donald Trump] blatantly laying the groundwork to steal an election if his chosen candidate doesn't win," Sen. Tina Smith, the outgoing Minnesota Democrat, wrote in an X post. "Minnesota will not take kindly to thinly veiled threats from a guy we've rejected three times (soon to be four)."
